units: SI: metre, kilogram, second, radian; angles explicitly suffixed _deg are degrees
description: WP1 generic valve geometry; default ball valve uses Bray Flow-Tek 7100 DN25 dimensions and an approved simplified flat lever. No manufacturer CAD or converted mesh is embedded.

pipe.provenance: 33.7 mm external diameter selected in the approved work package; bore, thread and flow omitted

ball.name: Bray-reference generic DN25 ball valve
ball.reference_product: Bray Flow-Tek 7000 series / 7100 threaded full-port, RPTFE seats
ball.safety_trigger_state: fixed unlocked / manufacturer-described bypass; trigger action omitted

provenance.catalogue_dimensions: Bray 7000/8000 brochure, page 10, DN25: A=92 mm for NPT/SW/BW, D=200 mm shaft-to-handle-end, C=87 mm pipe-axis-to-highest-point, C1=52 mm pipe-axis-to-mounting-top. Visual PDF dimension lines verified. H/J=35.7 mm are mounting hole spacings, not heights.
provenance.contact_shape_reference: User-approved 2026-10-21 generic bent flat metal lever with thin blue cover. It stays flat through the tip, without QH enlarged block/cylinder. Width 20 mm, covered total thickness 6 mm, metal plate 3 mm and bend positions are task assumptions, not Bray measurements.
provenance.assumptions: Body radii, rounded bolt envelopes, detailed cast shape, covered grip cross-section, bend location, moving mass/inertia and contact friction are simplified task settings. Simplified exterior only; internal ball, seals, threads, fluid and pressure omitted. Safety trigger held in the manufacturer-described bypass state; unlocking not part of this task.

globe.name: BOA-H dimension-reference DN25 handwheel globe valve

provenance.catalogue_dimensions: KSB BOA-H 7150.1/23-EN, table 7, DN25 PN16: d1=125 mm and l1=160 mm. h1=184 mm is an overall-height reference; its exact endpoint/state is not claimed here.
provenance.assumptions: Wheel elevation 178 mm, spoke/rim sections, flange/body outline, wheel mass/inertia, 2 mm screw pitch and 8 mm travel are temporary assumptions. Only the rotary joint is modelled; axial screw translation and internal disc/seal mechanics are omitted. Four turns is a configured task span, not a measured BOA-H turn count.

coordinate_convention.world: right-handed, Z up; camera on negative Y side
coordinate_convention.valve_local: pipe along X; stem and positive hinge axis along Z; ball open handle along +X
coordinate_convention.joint: valve_hinge, q=0 open. Positive q closes. Ball upper limit close_angle_deg; globe upper limit 2*pi*turns_open_to_closed.

sources.note: Bray-based generic task geometry, not an exact manufacturer replica. No Festo CAD/tessellation is used. Historical QH trials remain archived and do not define this current model.
sources.bray_dimensions_reference: Page 10, DN25, A=92, C=87, C1=52, D=200 mm; 7100 threaded end on page 11
